Herpes simplex infections. Although foscarnet is effective in the treatment of herpes simplex infections it is usually reserved for severe or disseminated herpes simplex infections, particularly in immunocompromised patients who have infections resistant to aciclovir (see p.854). A 2% cream applied topically is effec- tive in the treatment of refractory herpes simplex infections of the skin,1 and is licensed for such use in some countries.
